en:
Kokichi say stuff that hard to understand...
Make Gonta feel sleepy...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Gonta for a while?

O-Okay. Gonta like spending time with
Shuichi, but...

Yeah, yeah, I get it! I'm not wanted here!
I don't care, so do whatever you want!

S-Sorry, Kokichi.
Gonta come see you later...

What should we do, Shuichi? Gonta feel
like taking break...
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I took a well-earned break.
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I grew a little closer today.
